verdict.rationale: Relay's own docs say businesses can open up to 20 checking accounts and auto-transfer every deposit across them, by dollar amount or percentage. A hands-on community report confirms that automatic partitioning works, and a Wise review independently confirms the 20 checking accounts. missing for 10: in-depth first-party setup documentation for configuring deposit-triggered allocation rules (the support excerpts cover other features).

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can open multiple checking sub-accounts and auto-allocate incoming deposits across them

citations.quote: Open up to 20 checking accounts and auto-transfer every deposit so you always know what’s tied up and what’s safe to spend.
Automate transfers from one to multiple accounts using dollar amounts or percentages.
Relay does a good job of automatically partitioning money
You can have up to 20 individual checking accounts without any monthly fees on either plan.
